Accuracy columns are computed by ferroastro-bench from each tool's own output files, identically for every tool; a '–' always carries its reason in the notes under the table.
Mercury |Δr|: heliocentric, max over the common output times, against the scenario's reference run in this same harness invocation (REBOUND for (a) and (e); FerroAstro for (b) and (d)).

Perihelion rates: the WP14/WP17 Park2017 estimator (sampled-state passages, Park17 mean-orbit plane, quadratic + 14 Table-2 terms with SW92 T2A mean motions, 20 jack-knife blocks), window epoch + 30 d to end − 30 d, applied to each tool's daily twin (CI-009).
(a) Sun + 8 planets, Newtonian, 1000 yr: not run in this invocation (harness --only)
(b) Sun + Mercury with GR (1PN test particle), 1000 yr: not run in this invocation (harness --only)
(c) full Newtonian + 343 Minor asteroids + KBOs + ring, 100 yr: not run in this invocation (harness --only)
(d) Mercury in the DE440-driven field (stage B), 100 yr: not run in this invocation (harness --only)
